research_scope: valuation core only; no live parameter change

placebo.method: all non-zero circular shifts of the actual weight path; plus a seeded 1000-draw resample of those shifts

interpretation: The 63-month valuation-core sample does not show strong evidence of timing skill over an exposure-matched static portfolio. The observed timing edge is small, the t-stat is near zero, and the actual path ranks only around the 61st percentile of exact circular-shift placebos. This does not test the full live macro/earnings stack and does not alter the live allocator.
governance: Research evidence only. No automatic promotion or live model change.
